temporal_reconciliation.official_station_list_scope: Current East of England Ambulance Service station-list page read on 22 July 2026.
temporal_reconciliation.location_context_gate: Only the published sector, main depot / hub / admin base and station names are retained.
temporal_reconciliation.street_address_gate: The selected official station-list rows do not publish street addresses or postcodes; none are inferred.
temporal_reconciliation.operational_status_gate: Listing presence does not prove active staffing, public access, response capability, exclusive use or site type.

scope_policy: Current official EEAST page supports published station-list identity and grouping context only. Street address, postcode, public access, active staffing, response capability, exclusive use, canonical parcel ID, UPRN, title boundary, exact footprint, distance and property binding are not inferred.
